title: GRODE-RTL: Source-Mapped Dependency Views for LLM-Based RTL Repair
abstract: arXiv:2611.25661v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models show great potential for automated Register-Transfer Level repair, yet they struggle with non-local faults where root causes and failing outputs reside far apart in source code. Treating RTL as a flat token sequence obscures hardware dataflows, whereas exposing complete synthesized graphs overwhelms the model with fine-grained metadata. To resolve this representation dilemma, we propose GRODE-RTL, an anchor-centric representation that extracts the single-clock-stage fan-in cone of a suspect register from the netlist, maps netlist nodes back to editable source lines, and organizes them into a compact hop-partitioned dependency view. By prioritizing direct drivers and folding distant hops, GRODE-RTL guides standard tool-using agents without exposing ground-truth hints or oracle feedback. We evaluate GRODE-RTL across 30 formally validated non-local faults using three LLMs (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.2, and MiniMax-M3)

translated_title: GRODE-RTL：面向基于大语言模型的RTL修复的源码映射依赖视图
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在自动寄存器传输级（RTL）修复方面展现出巨大潜力，然而它们难以处理根源与故障输出在源代码中相距甚远的非局部故障。将RTL视为扁平的token序列会掩盖硬件数据流，而暴露完整的综合图则会用细粒度的元数据淹没模型。为解决这一表示困境，我们提出了GRODE-RTL，这是一种以锚点为中心的表示方法，它从网表中提取可疑寄存器的单时钟周期扇入锥，将网表节点映射回可编辑的源代码行，并将它们组织成紧凑的按跳数分区的依赖视图。通过优先考虑直接驱动信号并折叠远距离的跳数，GRODE-RTL能够在不暴露真实标签提示或oracle反馈的情况下引导标准的工具使用智能体。我们在30个经过形式化验证的非局部故障上，使用三个大语言模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GLM-5.2和MiniMax-M3）对GRODE-RTL进行了评估。
tldr: GRODE-RTL提出了一种以锚点为中心的表示方法，通过提取可疑寄存器的单时钟周期扇入锥、将网表节点映射回源代码行并构建紧凑的按跳分区依赖视图，帮助大语言模型在不依赖oracle反馈的情况下有效修复根源与故障输出相距甚远的非局部RTL故障。
en_tdlr: GRODE-RTL introduces an anchor-centric representation that extracts the single-clock-stage fan-in cone of a suspect register, maps netlist nodes back to source lines, and forms a compact hop-partitioned dependency view, enabling LLM-based agents to repair non-local RTL faults without oracle feedback.
